# Code Map — DriverField (Driver Field App)

Next.js 16 / React 19 installable PWA for a company-issued 10-inch LANDSCAPE tablet —
no phone breakpoints, no @media queries. Auth and the Driver role gate are real; every
other value on screen comes from lib/data.ts and each screen carries a MockTag.

23 files (the design system plus lib/inspectionForm.ts) are a **verbatim copy of Dispatcher** — change Dispatcher first,
then re-copy; never edit the copy in place. NavRail is deliberately NOT copied (its
geometry is hardcoded); the rail here is components/DutyRail.tsx. Sizes live in
lib/tablet.ts, colours in the copied lib/theme.ts. Manifest + drift check:
DriverField/CLAUDE.md.

lib/sync/ is the offline seam: real types, no-op bodies. Every screen mutation goes
through sync/queue.enqueue() so the offline batch stays additive.

<!-- notes:driverfield-screens:start -->
- Inspection.tsx is the NL-PTI-01 wizard (steps in screens/inspection/). Rev 4 post-trip = the six Close-Out rows, then NewDefectsStep ("Any defect found after the pre-trip?" — each new defect filed against a pre-trip item). Drafts persist locally; nothing is sent to the API.
- Today's "Open defects" tile counts the assigned vehicle only, WO-linked defects included; Vehicle.tsx also lists recentlyResolved ones (last 14 days).
- Hours.tsx is LIVE (no MockTag): every figure comes from lib/hos/ledger.ts through the one band set in lib/hos/display.ts, labelled as a planning figure (the record of duty status is the bus's ELD). HoursSheets.tsx holds its three compliance sheets — each runs the client mirror in lib/hos/complianceCommand.ts and hands back one payload for the screen to enqueue; no sheet touches the queue or API.
<!-- notes:driverfield-screens:end -->

- Console renders two app-local HOS surfaces over every screen: OutOfServiceScreen replaces the rail and all screens while an s.91 out-of-service declaration stands (from GET …/hos/status), and HosAlerts draws the 60/30-minute warnings (rules in lib/hos/useHosAlerts.ts).
- ui-tablet/DutyChip shows the four duty states from the copied theme's dutyMeta() — Personal Conveyance shares Off Duty's grey and is told apart by glyph + label; AttestationTile is a statement toggle (PersonalConveyanceModal's four, the exception sheet's s.76), not an action button.

## Lib — DriverField/lib (60 files)
<!-- gen:driverfield-lib:start -->
api/ (5): format, hos, hos.requests.test, shared, transport
Top-level: accessSeam.test, auth, claims.test, claims, clipboard, company, data, defects.test, eligibility.test, eligibility, format, inspectionForm.copy.test, inspectionForm, inspectionGate.test, inspectionGate, inspectionSteps.test, inspectionSteps, inspectionStore.test, inspectionStore, legal.test, legal, nav, newDefects.test, newDefects, period, roles.test, roles, tablet, theme, types, useInspectionStore, useToday, wire.test
hos/ (15)
sync/ (7)
<!-- gen:driverfield-lib:end -->
<!-- notes:driverfield-lib:start -->
- inspectionForm.ts is a 23rd byte-identical copy of Dispatcher's (the NL-PTI-01 catalogue; row keys are wire values) — inspectionForm.copy.test.ts fails on drift. Change Dispatcher first.
- newDefects.ts mirrors Dispatcher/components/inspection/checklistRows.ts without importing it; the tablet deltas: the No/Yes answer and each new defect's severity start null (unanswered).
- inspectionStore.ts: INSPECTION_STORE_VERSION 4 — a bump discards drafts, never migrates; certifications carry their own CERTIFIED_STORE_VERSION so a form revision can't re-block boarding.
- data.ts defects: open = not resolved (isDefectOpen: resolvedOn === null); a linked work order does NOT close one. inspectionGate.ts's boarding block is UX-only — no server precondition exists.
- HOS is LIVE (the header's "everything else is mock" predates it): hos/ledger.ts is the module-level store of the driver's last 14 duty days from api/hos.ts, read only via hos/useHosLedger.ts; hos/engine.ts (header copy) and hos/hos-fixtures.json are copies of Dispatcher/lib/hos, drift-tested. eligibility.ts (the §5.4 mirror) moved out of data.ts because it reads that live ledger. company.ts is app-local for now — its number is Dispatcher's COMPANY.phone, never edit it here.
- sync/ is no longer no-op bodies: queue.ts persists to IndexedDB (sync/db.ts) and drains each kind that has a registered sender (hos.duty / hos.certify / hos.exception … from hos/ledger.ts) with the command id as Idempotency-Key; a 4xx PARKS the command with the server's message (shown on Hours), never retried. Kinds without a sender are held and counted.
<!-- notes:driverfield-lib:end -->
